name: linkuistics
description: Grove's session methodology, coding standards, software design, project simplification, technical writing, and version-control disciplines as lazily loaded agent skills, the always-on hooks of the writing rules, and GUI testing in isolated VMs. Nine plugins: grove, requirements, design, engineering, research, writing, technical-communication-hooks, linkuistics and testanyware.

plugins.name: linkuistics
plugins.description: Linkuistics practice skills: Jujutsu-native version control and a user-invoked safety guardrail.

plugins.name: testanyware
plugins.description: TestAnyware GUI-testing skill: drive GUI apps in isolated macOS/Linux/Windows VMs for host-isolation, cross-platform testing, UI experiments, and documentation screenshots/recordings.

plugins.name: grove
plugins.description: Grove's methodology spine: the seven constraints, the bootstrap, execution, decomposition, retirement and commit procedures, the review and integration family files, and the five format documents.

plugins.name: requirements
plugins.description: Grove's requirements kinds: the requirements session with its interview procedure, and its review and integration steps.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Grove's design kinds, with their review and integration steps, and the design craft skills: decision records, codebase design, CLI tool design and model-led development.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Grove's impl and prototype kinds, with their review and integration steps, and the engineering craft skills: six coding styles, codebase-memory queries, project simplification and doubt-driven development.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Grove's research kinds: the research-a and research-b survey pair, their shared procedure, and the combine step.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Grove's editorial kinds: the draft, copy-edit, art and proof stages of a document's publishing pipeline, and their shared procedure. The writing craft skills: technical communication and code walkthrough authoring.

plugins.name: technical-communication-hooks
plugins.description: The always-on hooks of the technical-communication skill: the instruction, the reminder, the document gate and the reply log. This plugin holds no skill. The writing plugin or Ravel supplies the skill.
